exercise.directions: Read the scrambled preparation steps below. Sequence them in correct chronological order and rewrite the full process.
exercise.goal: Students sequence four mixed-up procedural steps for preparing an ofrenda and rewrite the full chronological process.

questions.answer: Correct chronological sequence: Card C (cleaning space), Card A (laying cloth and papel picado), Card D (placing photos and candles), Card B (adding favorite foods and water).
questions.prompt: Examine the four preparation steps above. Write the correct order numbers (1 to 4) in sequence to show how a family sets up the memorial altar correctly from start to finish.

questions.answer: Accept student paragraphs that accurately describe cleaning the space, decorating with textiles and banners, positioning photographs with glowing candles, and offering traditional foods and water.
questions.prompt: Now, rewrite the complete four-step process in your own words as a sequential paragraph, explaining why each stage is important for welcoming returning family members.

stimuli.label: Step Card A
stimuli.text: Spread a clean table cloth across the altar surface and hang colorful papel picado paper banners above to catch the gentle evening breezes.

stimuli.label: Step Card B
stimuli.text: Place fresh pan de muerto, bowls of warm mole, and a glass of fresh water on the altar so visiting spirits can enjoy their favorite aromas.

stimuli.label: Step Card C
stimuli.text: Carefully sweep and clean the wooden table where the memorial altar will stand, clearing away dust to prepare a respectful welcoming space.

stimuli.label: Step Card D
stimuli.text: Set framed photographs of beloved ancestors in the center, flanked by glowing beeswax candles and bright orange marigold flower petals.
